text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while Mejiro Ardan was training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, my body feels so heavy.
Could this be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My leg hurts a bit...
But it's nothing serious, just a little rest and...—
choice_data_list: No, let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
......I am terribly sorry.
It's all because of my own inadequacy—
choice_data_list: No. It's my negligence as your trainer
No. It's my negligence as your trainer

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems running in consecutive races recently
has placed an excessive burden on Mejiro Ardan's legs...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I need to review her upcoming race schedule and rebuild it so she doesn't run too many races in a row...
